$schema-note: Dated + justified exclusions for the Dockerfile base-image checks: tests/dockerfile-base-image-digests.test.ts (PR time: digest present, parseable, one repo:tag -> one digest) and scripts/verify-image-pins.mjs (nightly: digest still what the tag resolves to at the registry). Each entry MUST carry `file` and/or `image`, `covers` (any of: unpinned, unparseable, tag-digest-conflict, registry-resolution), `justification`, `added` and `expires` (ISO dates). Past `expires` the entry stops suppressing AND is itself a finding, so an exclusion cannot silently become permanent. Bump the pin FIRST; exclude only when it cannot be pinned or resolved. A `registry-resolution` entry MUST name the exact `file` AND the exact `digest` it tolerates; it cannot excuse any other digest on the same tag.

allow.justification: Locally built bake-off image (docker build -t scale-zero-pg/gateway:dev), never pushed to a registry, so there is no digest to pin; the Dockerfile re-bases its /gateway binary only.

Benchmark variants build FROM a private Artifact Registry baseline (bc-bun-turbopack) referenced digest-only; the nightly has no credential for it and the digest is the experiment's fixed control, not a moving tag. Bound to this exact digest: a different digest in this file is NOT excused.
